name: Hotel Garni Bergland
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Bergland is located in Neustift im Stubaital, approximately 20 km south of Innsbruck. Set amidst the magnificent Stubai Alps, it is an ideal launching pad with hiking and biking trails starting right on the doorstep. The world-famous Stubai Glacier and the Schlick 2000 ski area are easily reached by car or ski bus. This family-operated hotel features balcony rooms, a rejuvenating sauna area, and a daily breakfast buffet.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Bergland in Neustift im Stubaital provides family-run hospitality, a relaxing sauna area, balcony rooms, and convenient access to the Stubai Glacier.
